testCases.title: User can search flights from Delhi to Mumbai for a selected departure date
steps: Enter valid source and destination (Delhi and Mumbai)
Select a valid departure date (today or tomorrow)
Verify that search results are displayed with flight details
testCases.expectedResult: Search results are displayed with flight details

testCases.title: No flights available for a selected departure date
steps: Verify that a clear message is displayed indicating no flights are available
testCases.expectedResult: Clear message is displayed indicating no flights are available

testCases.title: No flights available for a selected departure date - Edge case (same day departure)
steps: Verify that a clear message is displayed indicating no flights are available
testCases.expectedResult: Clear message is displayed indicating no flights are available

testCases.title: User can search flights from Delhi to Mumbai for a selected departure date with no filters applied
steps: Click the search button without applying any filters
Verify that search results are displayed with flight details
testCases.expectedResult: Search results are displayed with flight details

testCases.title: User can search flights from Delhi to Mumbai for a selected departure date with a specific filter applied
steps: Apply a specific filter (e.g. budget, airline)
Verify that search results are displayed with flight details
testCases.expectedResult: Search results are displayed with filtered flight details

testCases.title: Validation error for invalid input
steps: Verify that a validation error is displayed

testCases.title: Error handling for network issue
steps: Verify that an error message is displayed
